body.title: Everything your centre runs on
body.description: One integrated platform from the first family enquiry to daily care, communication, and billing. Every record is created once and used everywhere.

features.title: Admissions
features.description: Configurable admission form builder with per-program templates and conditional fields, parent magic-link onboarding, staff fill-on-behalf, enrollment fee summary emails, and one-click approval into student records and first invoices.

features.title: Leads Pipeline
features.description: Capture website enquiries, review optional AI chat conversations, and convert qualified families into admissions without a separate CRM. Staff manually convert leads to the pipeline.

features.title: Attendance
features.description: Daily check-in and check-out, QR scan check-in, leave requests with staff approval, and a real-time picture of who is in for admins and families.

features.title: Activity Feed
features.description: Teachers log meals, naps, learning, mood, and milestones in seconds. Optional Write with AI drafts from a short note and/or photos; staff review before posting. Photo attachments reach families through private storage, scoped to authorised parents only.

features.title: Messaging
features.description: 1:1 conversations between parents, teachers, and admins, plus broadcasts for closures and reminders. Staff can draft DMs and broadcasts with Write with AI, then review and send. Realtime inbox updates and email notifications when configured.

features.title: AI Translation
features.description: On-demand Translate on messages, broadcasts, and activity updates in 100+ languages. Twenty popular choices listed first for UAE and international nurseries; search finds the rest. Parents and staff save a preferred language on their profile. Unlimited for normal daycare use.

features.title: Billing
features.description: Reusable fee plans, billing runs, parent payment proof workflow, credit notes, and account statements with tax frozen at issue time. Admins can also run a fee estimator and download a branded PDF estimate with the centre logo.

features.title: Student Lifecycle
features.description: Manage withdrawal with retention policies, archives, re-enrollment for returning families, and program promotion to the next classroom. Printable student ID cards with custom templates, PDF preview, and single or bulk generation.

features.title: Write with AI
features.description: Optional drafts for activities (from a note and/or up to 4 photos), progress summaries, staff notes, DMs, and broadcasts. Staff always review before posting or sending. Parents never see Write with AI; they use Translate when they need another language.

features.title: Student ID Cards
features.description: Design custom ID card templates for your centre, preview with sample or selected students, and generate single-card or bulk PDFs for printing.

features.title: Admin Tools
features.description: Fee estimator with branded PDF download for program and add-on combinations. Quick helpers also cover age and program eligibility checks, classroom occupancy snapshots, and compliance CSV exports for licensing packs.

features.title: Help Center
features.description: Role-specific guides for admins, teachers, and parents so teams can learn workflows inside Clayox without leaving the portal.

features.title: Embeddable Enquiry Forms
features.description: Drop enquiry forms into your existing centre website with consent capture. Leads land in your admin board for review and one-click admission conversion.

features.title: White-label Branding
features.description: Your centre name, logo, and favicon on your dedicated deployment. Parents and staff see your brand in the portals they use daily, and invoice PDFs carry your centre's branding.

body.faq_description: Common questions about Clayox, admissions, operations, billing, and platform setup.

faqs.question: Is Clayox only for UAE centres?
faqs.answer: No. Clayox is built for early childhood education providers worldwide. Currency, timezone, and tax/VAT are configurable per deployment. The UAE is our primary market, not the geographic limit of the product.

faqs.question: Who is Clayox for?
faqs.answer: Clayox serves preschools, nurseries, childcare centres, early learning centres, Montessori schools, kindergartens, and playschools. It is designed for centres that need admissions, daily care, family communication, and billing in one platform.

faqs.question: How does magic-link admission onboarding work?
faqs.answer: Admins send a one-shot magic-link invite to a parent's email. Parents complete configurable admission forms at their own pace, including child, guardian, sibling, and document upload steps. Staff can fill forms on behalf of families when needed, email an enrollment fee summary, then approve in one click to create student records and first invoices.

faqs.question: Can we embed enquiry forms on our existing website?
faqs.answer: Yes. Clayox provides embeddable enquiry forms for lead capture on your centre website, plus a hosted register page alternative. Leads land in your admin lead board with consent proof. This is enquiry and lead capture, not a hosted visit booking page.

faqs.question: Can teachers log attendance and activities from mobile?
faqs.answer: Yes. Teacher and family portals are responsive and mobile-ready, with PWA add-to-homescreen support. Teachers can run attendance, log activities, and message families from phones and tablets in the classroom.

faqs.question: Does billing support tax and VAT configuration?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each deployment supports configurable currency, timezone, and tax/VAT settings. Tax rates are frozen on each invoice at issue time, with per-line taxable flags and audit-logged billing runs.

faqs.question: Is each centre on its own deployment?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each centre runs on a dedicated single-tenant deployment with its own database, private storage, and CDN. This keeps centre data isolated and supports configurable regional settings.

faqs.question: What does white-label mean for Clayox?
faqs.answer: White-label means the software runs under your centre's brand, not the vendor's. Your centre name, logo, and favicon appear on your dedicated deployment, and invoice PDFs carry your branding. Parents and staff experience your centre's identity; Clayox powers the platform behind the scenes.

faqs.question: Is Clayox white-labelled for each centre?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each centre gets a dedicated deployment with your branding: centre name, logo, favicon, and branded invoice and receipt PDFs. Your families experience your centre's identity on a platform built for early childhood operations.

faqs.question: What roles and permissions are supported?
faqs.answer: Clayox includes 8-role role-based access control with granular permissions across Admin, Teacher, and Family portals. Staff, classroom, and billing access can be scoped to each centre's needs.

faqs.question: What is Write with AI, and does it auto-post?
faqs.answer: Write with AI drafts staff content for activities, progress summaries, staff notes, DMs, and broadcasts. It never auto-posts or auto-sends. Staff review and edit before anything reaches families. Parents do not see Write with AI; they use on-demand Translate when they need another language. Learn more at clayox.com/ai-write-childcare-updates.

faqs.question: Do you support online card payment gateways?
faqs.answer: Not yet. Clayox supports invoice-first billing with parent payment proof submissions and manual payment recording by admins. Automated card and online payment gateways are on the roadmap, not available today.

faqs.question: Can we print student ID cards?
faqs.answer: Yes. Admins can design custom ID card templates, preview PDFs with sample or selected students, and generate single-card or bulk print-ready PDFs.

faqs.question: Is AI translation included in Clayox?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI translation is included for normal daycare use. Parents and staff can tap Translate on messages, broadcasts, and activity updates in 100+ languages. Preferred language is saved on user profiles for one-tap translate.

faqs.question: How many languages does Clayox translation support?
faqs.answer: Clayox supports the full ISO 639-1 language list (100+ languages). Twenty popular languages for UAE and international nurseries are listed first; search finds the rest. Learn more at clayox.com/ai-translation.

faqs.question: Does the AI enquiry assistant auto-create leads?
faqs.answer: No. The optional AI enquiry assistant captures conversations for admin review. Your team manually converts qualified enquiries to the leads pipeline. Nothing is auto-logged without staff action.

faqs.question: Is the AI enquiry assistant included for all centres?
faqs.answer: The AI enquiry assistant is optional and deployable for subscribing centres. It works alongside embeddable enquiry forms and the leads pipeline. IGENTX can also help implement the AI Customer Service Agent on your centre website.

faqs.question: Can parents view daily activities and message teachers?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Family portal provides a per-child activity feed scoped to authorised parents, plus 1:1 messaging with teachers and admins. Broadcasts cover closures, events, and centre-wide reminders.

faqs.question: How do I get started with Clayox?
faqs.answer: Visit clayox.com to explore the product and request a demo. For implementation support, custom rollout, or combining Clayox with website and AI enquiry solutions, talk to the IGENTX team.
